why: The same short note as short-post.html, on the page an ordinary site would serve it on: a nav, a cookie notice, a sidebar of thirty other posts and a footer. Its share of the page is 0.21, under the threshold, so the only thing keeping it is the floor on its own size. Without this case the share could be tightened until it swallowed every short post published on a site with a sidebar, and the corpus would not notice.
